messages:
Eleni Vass: Dropping a quick mock for the Embeddings Rerank panel after batch upload. Focus: clarity around preview sampling, export labels, and small a11y fixes. https://staging.redwood.host/preview-embed :wave:
Marco Diaz: First pass: make it explicit when preview is sampled. I suggest: 'Previewing 200 of 50,000 rows'. Otherwise users assume it's full.
Ivy Chen: Export copy should be explicit: primary CTA 'Download: Vectors + Scores (NDJSON)', secondary 'Download: Metadata only (CSV)'. Also show estimated file size and row count before download.
a11y-bot: a11y-scan: color contrast issue on relevance heatmap; table headers need sort state exposed to screen readers; ensure modal focus trap.
Eleni Vass: Adding NDJSON snippet in modal and a tiny sample line. Also: toggle to expand full vector per row but cap to 20 rows and require confirm for raw vectors. We should warn: 'Viewing raw vectors may expose user content.'
Marco Diaz: Move similarity score column next to text column for easier scanning. Add aria-live announcements for sort changes: 'Sorted by relevance, highest first'.
Ivy Chen: For big exports we'll stream and estimate size; infra should tag telemetry with sample_count and duration. Also add tooltip on export: 'Includes raw vectors and scores  check policies if needed.'
Eleni Vass: I'll update mock with these fixes (focus trap, explicit sampling copy, export labels, NDJSON preview, limit expand) and open PR. Thanks all.
